title: AlgoEvo: Self-Evolving Agentic Search for Automated Algorithm Discovery
summary: Large language models have advanced automated algorithm discovery by synthesizing executable code, but existing frameworks trap them in rigid search pipelines with pre-defined control flows. This limitation restricts adaptive reasoning, blocks cross-paradigm transfer, and discards valuable execution feedback. We propose AlgoEvo, a unified agentic framework that transforms automated algorithm discovery into an interactive, knowledge-accumulating process. An autonomous agent dynamically inspects, diagnoses, and edits code based on runtime feedback. A design skill hub decouples paradigm-specific knowledge from the core discovery engine, allowing a single workflow to seamlessly handle single-objective, multi-objective, and multi-component design. Meanwhile, a hierarchical experience mechanism organizes search trajectories into a task-level tree to guide exploration and consolidates cross-task patterns into reusable skills. Across six representative benchmark tasks, AlgoEvo matches or surpasses specialized methods with substantially fewer evaluations and reduced token consumption, demonstrating strong intra-task accumulation, cross-task transfer, and the ability to reproduce or exceed existing state-of-the-art performance through flexible skill activation.

AI.tldr: AlgoEvo将自动化算法发现重构为交互式、知识累积的智能体框架，通过自主智能体基于运行时反馈迭代修改代码、设计技能中心解耦范式知识、分层经验机制组织搜索轨迹与跨任务技能，在六项基准任务上以更少评估和token超越或匹配专用方法。
AI.motivation: 现有基于大语言模型的算法发现框架受限于预定义控制流的刚性搜索流程，限制了自适应推理、阻碍跨范式迁移，并浪费了执行反馈信息。
AI.method: 提出统一智能体框架AlgoEvo：1) 自主智能体依据运行时反馈动态检查、诊断并编辑代码；2) 设计技能中心将范式特定知识与核心发现引擎解耦，使单一工作流处理单目标、多目标与多组件设计；3) 分层经验机制将搜索轨迹组织为任务级树以引导探索，并将跨任务模式整合为可复用技能。
AI.result: 在六个代表性基准任务上，AlgoEvo以显著更少的评估次数与更低的token消耗，达到或超过专用方法，并展现出强的任务内累积、跨任务迁移能力，以及通过灵活技能激活复现或超越现有最优性能的能力。
AI.conclusion: AlgoEvo验证了将算法发现转为交互式、知识累积过程的有效性，具备跨范式泛化与经验复用优势。

title: MOSCOPT: Mixture-of-Skills Collective Optimization for LLM Agents
summary: Natural language prompts and skills serve as the strategic backbone of LLM-based agents. Recent advances in prompt and skill optimization have achieved notable gains, yet all existing methods optimize a \emph{single} text template---missing the synergy among multiple complementary strategies. We propose MOSCOPT, a text-native, parameter-free algorithm that jointly optimizes a pool of $N$ skills and a gating skill $G$ that dynamically selects $K$ skills per step. To effectively optimize the skills, we build the EditAdam with internally maintained dual states. Through the three-phase interleaved updates with EditAdam, the system monotonically improves without gradient or parameter tuning. Extensive experiments and detailed ablations across 5 benchmarks and 3 target LLMs demonstrate that MOSCOPT consistently outperforms all baselines, and confirm that both the mixture-of-skills architecture with selective activation and the collective evolution with three-phase interleaving are essential to its superior performance. Code is released https://github.com/zhangzhenyu13/SummerClaw/tree/master/summerclaw/agent_trainer/algorithms/moscopt.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 MOSCOPT，一种文本原生、无参数的算法，联合优化 N 个技能池与一个门控技能 G（每步动态选择 K 个技能），并借助 EditAdam 的三阶段交错更新实现单调提升。
AI.motivation: 现有提示与技能优化方法仅优化单一文本模板，忽略了多种互补策略之间的协同效应。
AI.method: MOSCOPT 采用技能混合（mixture-of-skills）架构与选择性激活机制：维护含 N 个技能的池和一个门控技能 G，每步动态选取 K 个技能；通过内部维护双状态的 EditAdam，以三阶段交错更新方式联合优化，全程无需梯度与参数调优。
AI.result: 在 5 个基准与 3 个目标 LLM 上的大量实验与消融表明，MOSCOPT 持续优于所有基线；并证实技能混合+选择性激活架构与三阶段交错的集体演化对性能优势均为必要。
AI.conclusion: MOSCOPT 以无参数、文本原生方式实现多技能协同优化，显著提升 LLM 智能体的提示/技能优化效果。

relevance.reason: 提出文本原生无参数算法联合优化LLM智能体的技能池与选择门控，属于LLM智能体作为优化器/控制器的核心方向，与LLM+优化算法设计高度相关。

title: Dream-RSI: Recursive Self-Improvement through Evolving Worlds
summary: Recursive self-improvement is becoming increasingly vital for autonomous AI agents, where progress hinges on discovering high-value solutions across complex domains. The driver of this process is effective exploration, however, managing and improving exploration strategies remains a major bottleneck. Current systems face a fundamental dilemma: fixed strategies fail to adapt as search spaces scale, while online policy optimization requires navigating vast meta-search spaces under delayed and expensive feedback over long-horizon rollouts. We introduce \textsc{Dream-RSI}, a framework for scalable and recursively self-improving exploration. A lightweight orchestration layer makes exploration explicit and programmable while leaving the underlying coding agent unchanged. Our key insight is that accumulated discovery history can serve as a replay simulator over the realized search space. By performing dreaming in the replay simulator constructed from historical discovery trees, \textsc{Dream-RSI} secures immediate, low-cost off-policy feedback to evaluate and refine exploration policies without invoking repetitive, expensive online evaluations. The improved policy is subsequently redeployed online to drive further discovery, continuously expanding the simulator pool in a self-improving loop. Across algorithm engineering, mathematical optimization, and GPU kernel engineering, \textsc{Dream-RSI} achieves competitive or improved discovery quality while substantially reducing discovery cost in several settings.

AI.tldr: 提出 Dream-RSI，将累积的发现历史构建为回放模拟器，通过在模拟器中进行"做梦"来低成本地评估与改进探索策略，从而缓解固定策略失效与在线策略优化代价高昂的两难问题，并在算法工程、数学优化与 GPU 内核工程任务上取得竞争力或更优的发现质量。
AI.motivation: 递归自我改进对自主 AI 智能体愈发关键，其进展取决于在复杂领域中寻找高价值解，而有效探索是核心驱动力。然而探索策略的管理与改进存在瓶颈：固定策略无法适应搜索空间规模扩张；在线策略优化则需在延迟且昂贵的反馈下搜索庞大的元搜索空间，且涉及长时程 rollout。因此需要一种可扩展、可递归自我改进的探索框架。
AI.method: 提出 Dream-RSI 框架。采用轻量级编排层使探索显式化、可编程化，保持底层编码智能体不变。核心思路是将累积的发现历史视为已实现搜索空间上的回放模拟器：利用历史发现树构建模拟器，在其中进行 dreaming，从而获得即时、低成本的离策略反馈，用于评估与改进探索策略，避免重复且昂贵的在线评估。改进后的策略再部署回在线环境驱动进一步发现，持续扩充模拟器池，形成自我改进闭环。
AI.result: 在算法工程、数学优化和 GPU 内核工程三类任务上，Dream-RSI 取得了与基线相当或更优的发现质量，同时在多种设置下显著降低了发现成本。
AI.conclusion: 将发现历史复用为回放模拟器以获取廉价离策略反馈，是一种可行且有效的探索策略自我改进路径，能够在保持发现质量的同时降低探索开销，为自主智能体的递归自我改进提供了可扩展的方案。

relevance.reason: 提出可编程探索策略的递归自改进框架，用回放模拟器进行离线策略优化，驱动算法工程与数学优化等领域的自动发现，涉及LLM智能体、强化学习与优化算法发现的核心交叉。

title: LLM-Enhanced Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning for Unified Electric Vehicles-Charging Station-Grid Optimization in Public Charging Systems
summary: In the era of the Internet of Things (IoT), coordinating connected electric vehicle (EV) charging scheduling to balance EV charging satisfaction, station profitability, and smart grid stability presents a complex multi-objective challenge. Existing Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning (MARL) approaches often struggle with high-dimensional state spaces generated by massive IoT sensing data and conflicting stakeholder interests. This paper proposes a novel LLM-enhanced MARL framework that, for the first time, simultaneously optimizes the Grid, EVs, and Stations within a unified loop. By integrating Large Language Model (LLM), we address two critical bottlenecks: interpretable feature selection and adaptive multi-objective balancing. The LLM analyzes real-time IoT-collected environmental states to extract physically significant features and dynamically assigns weights to conflicting objectives-including profit, user satisfaction, and grid load-using semantic reasoning instead of complex manual tuning. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our framework significantly outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, achieving superior market efficiency while reducing training time by over 70%. This approach offers a scalable, transparent solution for efficient and sustainable IoT-enabled urban charging infrastructure management.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种LLM增强的MARL框架，首次在统一闭环中同时优化电网、电动汽车与充电站三方利益，通过LLM实现可解释特征选择与自适应多目标权重分配，实验显著优于SOTA基线并将训练时间缩短70%以上。
AI.motivation: 物联网环境下，协同电动汽车充电调度需同时平衡充电满意度、充电站盈利与电网稳定性，构成复杂多目标问题。现有MARL方法难以应对海量IoT传感数据带来的高维状态空间以及多方利益冲突，且多目标权衡通常依赖人工调参、缺乏可解释性。
AI.method: 提出LLM增强的MARL框架，在统一闭环中联合优化电网、EV与充电站。利用LLM分析IoT实时采集的环境状态，完成两项关键任务：一是可解释的特征选择，提取具有物理意义的特征以缓解高维状态空间问题；二是基于语义推理动态分配利润、用户满意度、电网负载等冲突目标的权重，替代复杂的人工调参。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，该框架显著优于当前最先进的基线方法，在提升市场效率的同时将训练时间缩短70%以上。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为IoT赋能的城市充电基础设施管理提供了一种可扩展、透明且高效可持续的解决方案，验证了LLM与MARL结合在复杂多目标协同调度中的有效性。

relevance.reason: 将LLM与多智能体强化学习结合用于多目标优化调度，属于LLM+RL+优化的交叉方向，具较强相关性。

title: ModularRSI: Modular and Generalizable Recursive Harness Self-Improvement
summary: Recent work extends recursive self-improvement (RSI) to agent harnesses for long-horizon coding and terminal tasks, enabling agents to improve execution mechanisms from experience. However, generalizable harness RSI remains challenging. First, evolving harnesses on evaluation benchmarks or their subsets makes it difficult to distinguish reusable improvements from benchmark-specific adaptation. Second, single-trajectory updates can conflate systematic harness deficiencies with instance-specific reasoning and solution details, producing modifications that transfer poorly to unseen tasks. Third, localizing recurring behavioral deficiencies within monolithic harnesses is difficult, while whole-harness optimization can entangle unrelated mechanisms and complicate attribution and validation. We propose ModularRSI, a benchmark-disjoint, contrastive, and modular framework for generalizable harness evolution. ModularRSI contrasts successful and failed trajectories for the same task and aggregates evidence across tasks to identify recurring behavioral deficiencies. It decomposes the evolvable harness into five functional modules: Agent Loop, Tool Use, Observation Management, Context Management, and Task Completion Detection. Each module evolves independently within a restricted modification scope, followed by an integration stage that combines the evolved modules into a unified harness and resolves potential conflicts. To support benchmark-disjoint evolution, we curate 2,000 executable evolution tasks from external sources that are disjoint from downstream evaluation benchmarks. Experiments on TB2.0 and SWE-Bench Verified show consistent improvements on unseen in-domain and cross-domain tasks, with the evolved harness also transferring across different foundation models.

AI.tldr: 提出ModularRSI框架，通过基准分离、对比学习与模块化设计实现可泛化的智能体执行框架递归自我改进。
AI.motivation: 现有将递归自我改进（RSI）扩展到长程编码与终端任务的智能体执行框架时，难以实现可泛化的改进：1）在评测基准或其子集上演化难以区分可复用改进与基准特定适配；2）单轨迹更新会混淆系统性缺陷与实例特定细节，迁移性差；3）单体式框架中难以定位复现性行为缺陷，整体优化会纠缠无关机制，妨碍归因与验证。
AI.method: ModularRSI采用三重设计：1）基准分离——从外部来源构建2000个可执行演化任务，与下游评测基准不相交；2）对比式——对同一任务的成功与失败轨迹进行对比，并跨任务聚合证据以识别复现性行为缺陷；3）模块化——将可演化执行框架分解为Agent Loop、Tool Use、Observation Management、Context Management、Task Completion Detection五个功能模块，各模块在受限修改范围内独立演化，随后经集成阶段合并为统一框架并解决潜在冲突。
AI.result: 在TB2.0与SWE-Bench Verified上，对未见过的同域与跨域任务均取得一致提升，且演化后的执行框架可跨不同基础模型迁移。
AI.conclusion: 基准分离、对比诊断与模块化演化三者的结合，可有效提升执行框架RSI的泛化能力，实现跨任务域与跨基础模型的迁移。

relevance.title_zh: ModularRSI：模块化与可泛化的递归框架自我改进

title: Surrogate-Assisted Genetic Programming with Phenotypic Characterisation in Dynamic Multi-Mode Project Scheduling
summary: Dynamic multi-mode resource-constrained project scheduling requires decisions to be made under precedence constraints, limited resources, multiple execution modes, and uncertain activity durations. Genetic programming (GP) can automatically evolve heuristic rules for such problems, but its simulation-based fitness evaluation is computationally expensive. This study investigates phenotypic characterisation (PC) in surrogate-assisted GP to evolve higher-quality scheduling heuristics under a fixed budget of full simulation-based fitness evaluations. A key question is how GP individuals should be encoded into phenotypic characterisations to support effective fitness estimation. To answer this question, three PC encoding schemes with different levels of information richness are designed: priority-value encoding, which preserves raw rule outputs; rank encoding, which captures candidate ordering; and binary encoding, which represents final scheduling decisions. These encodings are combined with different distance metrics to measure behavioural similarity between GP individuals. The experimental results show that binary encoding with Euclidean distance provides the most effective and robust surrogate guidance. Further analyses show that surrogate estimation accuracy alone does not fully explain the performance differences. The PC representation also determines how effectively phenotypically redundant offspring are removed and how much behavioural diversity is retained after preselection. Ablation experiments further demonstrate that duplicate removal and surrogate preselection provide complementary benefits, with their combination producing the largest improvement. These findings highlight that effective surrogate-assisted GP depends not only on identifying promising offspring, but also on controlling redundancy and preserving useful diversity during evolutionary search.

AI.tldr: 本文研究代理辅助遗传编程（GP）中的表型表征（PC），为动态多模式资源受限项目调度问题设计三种不同信息丰富度的PC编码方案，并探讨其与距离度量的组合效果。
AI.motivation: 动态多模式资源受限项目调度需在先序约束、有限资源、多种执行模式和不确定工期下决策；GP虽能自动演化启发式规则，但基于仿真的适应度评估计算代价高昂，故需在固定仿真评估预算下提升演化启发式质量。
AI.method: 设计三种信息丰富度不同的PC编码：保留规则原始输出的优先值编码、刻画候选排序的排名编码、表示最终调度决策的二元编码；将其与不同距离度量结合以衡量GP个体间的行为相似性，并进行消融实验分析去重与代理预选择的作用。
AI.result: 二元编码结合欧氏距离提供最有效且稳健的代理引导；代理估计精度本身不能完全解释性能差异；PC表示还决定表型冗余后代的剔除效果及预选择后行为多样性的保留程度；重复剔除与代理预选择具有互补收益，二者结合带来最大改进。
AI.conclusion: 有效的代理辅助GP不仅在于识别有前景的后代，还在于演化搜索过程中控制冗余并保留有用多样性。

title: HypoEvolve: Genetic Algorithms Enable Multi-Agent LLMs to Discover Scientific Hypotheses
summary: Scientific agents contribute to hypothesis discovery by synthesizing evidence, assessing proposals, and developing new explanations. Recent systems combine scientific agents with evolutionary search through critique, comparison, and revision. However, how different forms of agent collaboration affect hypothesis quality remains an open question. Answering this question requires separating the effects of agents' scientific capabilities from those of their collaboration. A framework must therefore preserve agents' scientific roles and support rules for combining, revising, and retaining hypotheses. Building on this view, we introduce HypoEvolve, which makes collaboration explicit through successive updates to a hypothesis population. Specifically, we propose a generational genetic algorithm to coordinate specialized large language model (LLM) agents that integrate mechanistic arguments, reconsider assumptions, and assess evidence and testability. Each generation specifies how scientific judgments and new proposals reshape the population, making collaboration effects on hypothesis quality directly testable. Moreover, we design our evaluation around scientifically meaningful hypotheses that explain how a proposed intervention could work. Drug repurposing links these explanations to target-level biological claims assessed against external evidence. Specifically, we adapt DepMap and Open Targets into complementary external measures grounded in experimental, genetic, and clinical evidence. Across 34 cancer types, HypoEvolve achieves the highest scores against six baselines on both measures. DepMap selectivity reaches 0.171, versus 0.115 for the strongest baseline. Gains over single-pass generation also generalize to held-out cancer types. HypoEvolve advances a vision of autonomous science in which AI research teams achieve a capacity for discovery beyond that of individual models.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 HypoEvolve，通过世代遗传算法显式建模 LLM 科学智能体之间的协作，以检验协作形式对假设质量的影响，并在药物重定位任务上验证其有效性。
AI.motivation: 现有系统将科学智能体与进化搜索结合，通过批评、比较与修订来发现假设，但不同形式的智能体协作如何影响假设质量仍不清楚。回答该问题需要将智能体自身的科学能力与协作效应分离，因此需构建能保留智能体科学角色、并支持假设组合、修订与保留规则的框架。
AI.method: 提出 HypoEvolve，通过迭代更新假设种群使协作显式化。设计世代遗传算法协调专门化 LLM 智能体，使其整合机制论证、重新审视假设前提、评估证据与可检验性；每一世代明确科学判断与新提案如何重塑种群，从而使协作对假设质量的影响可直接检验。评估围绕可解释干预机制的科学假设设计，以药物重定位将解释与靶点层面生物学主张关联，并改编 DepMap 与 Open Targets 作为基于实验、遗传与临床证据的互补外部指标。
AI.result: 在 34 种癌症类型上，HypoEvolve 在两项指标上均优于六个基线方法。DepMap 选择性达到 0.171，最强基线为 0.115。相对于单次生成方法的提升可泛化到留出的癌症类型。
AI.conclusion: HypoEvolve 推进了自主科学愿景，即 AI 研究团队能够实现超越单个模型的发现能力，并表明协作机制本身是假设质量提升的可测来源。

title: Toward Self-Adaptive Physical AI: Can LLM Agents Manage Long-Horizon Physical Tasks?
summary: Large Language Model (LLM) agents offer a promising path toward autonomously managing long-term physical tasks without human intervention. However, physical tasks require agents to continuously observe the environment, make consequential actions, and remain effective as the environment changes. Existing approaches either require substantial data and retraining, or primarily focus on agents operating in the virtual world. In this work, we explore the feasibility of building a self-adaptive physical AI agent that manages long-term physical tasks in a zero-shot manner and adapts to environmental changes without human intervention. We design a multi-agent framework that integrates planning, tool calling, observation, and verification, and evaluate it on agricultural tasks against reinforcement learning (RL) agents under different weather patterns. Our results show that zero-shot LLM agents can achieve comparable management outcomes to RL agents under the same weather pattern and adapt more effectively than RL when evaluated under a shifted environment, highlighting a promising path toward self-adaptive physical AI agents.

AI.tldr: 本文探索构建能够在零样本条件下自主管理长期物理任务、无需人工干预即可适应环境变化的自适应物理AI智能体，并设计多智能体框架在农业任务上与强化学习（RL）智能体对比验证其可行性。
AI.motivation: 长期物理任务要求智能体持续观察环境、执行有后果的动作并在环境变化时保持有效性。现有方法要么需要大量数据和重训练，要么主要聚焦于虚拟世界中的智能体，难以满足真实物理场景中零样本、自适应的长期管理需求。

title: Partition Scores Are Not System Scores: Deployment-Fidelity Gaps in Decomposed Algorithm Selection
summary:
Oracle-style quantities, including virtual best solvers, selected-portfolio VBS, virtual-best encodings, and best-in-family summaries, are widely reported as upper bounds on what a deployable selector could achieve. In decomposed algorithm selection, an analogous partition-level score grants an oracle choice of the best algorithm within the selected family; once the family selector is fixed, the deployable system must replace that within-family oracle with a learned within-family selector.
  We define the deployment-fidelity gap G(R) as the difference between partition-level and deployable end-to-end utility and derive two accounting consequences: a per-instance margin-regret stability condition that tells us when a partition-time family choice is deployment-optimal, and a sharp partition-only identification interval that, when it strictly crosses zero, prevents the partition-level report from certifying the deployable winner.
  Across five public algorithm-selection benchmarks spanning tabular AutoML and combinatorial CSP/SAT, every decomposed pipeline has positive G(R), ranging from 0.012 on TabZilla to 0.13 on PROTEUS-2014. Four of ten decomposed-versus-flat decisions have sign-changing point estimates; on PROTEUS-2014, a 33-point partition advantage shrinks to a 20-point end-to-end advantage. A training-side validation gap-correction diagnostic recovers the point-estimate deployable sign on all four sign-changing cells; it is a reporting aid, not a substitute for direct end-to-end evaluation. Partition and end-to-end scores should be reported side by side.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"部署保真度差距"G(R)，指出分解决策中分区级oracle打分高估了可部署系统的性能，并给出两个理论刻画与跨基准实证。
AI.motivation: 虚最优（VBS）等oracle风格指标被广泛当作可部署选择器性能的上界。在分解式算法选择中，分区级分数隐含了"族内最优算法"的oracle选择，但部署时该oracle必须被学习到的族内选择器替代，因此分区级报告可能系统性高估实际可部署性能，缺少对此差距的明确定义与量化。
AI.method: 定义部署保真度差距G(R)为分区级效用与可部署端到端效用之差；推导两条核算结论：逐实例的边际后悔稳定性条件（判定分区时族选择是否部署最优）与紧的分区-only识别区间（当区间严格跨零时，分区级报告无法认证可部署赢家）。在五个公开算法选择基准（表格AutoML与组合CSP/SAT）上，对比分解式与扁平式流水线，并引入训练侧验证差距校正诊断。
AI.result: 所有分解式流水线G(R)均为正，范围从TabZilla的0.012到PROTEUS-2014的0.13。十个"分解式对扁平式"决策中有四个点估计符号发生翻转；PROTEUS-2014上33个百分点的分区优势缩小为20个百分点的端到端优势。训练侧验证差距校正诊断在全部四个符号翻转单元格上恢复了点估计的可部署符号。
AI.conclusion: 分区级oracle分数并非可部署性能的有效认证，G(R)普遍为正且可导致比较结论翻转；该诊断仅为报告辅助手段，不能替代直接的端到端评估。建议将分区分数与端到端分数并排报告。

title: Graph Neural Networks for Influence Maximization in Social Networks: An Unsupervised Minimum Dominating Set Approach
comment: 16 pages, 1 figure, 4 tables. Submitted to the International Journal of Data Science and Analytics
summary: The Minimum Dominating Set (MDS) problem is a classic NP-hard combinatorial optimization problem with critical applications in social network analysis, including viral marketing, influence maximization, public health interventions, and information dissemination. Identifying a minimal set of influential individuals whose reach covers an entire social network is central to these applications, yet remains computationally challenging at scale. Graph neural networks (GNNs) have emerged as powerful tools for learning over graphs, and recent work explores their application to hard combinatorial problems. This paper presents a novel unsupervised GNN framework for the MDS problem that eliminates the need for ground-truth solutions during training. Trained on 12,000 synthetic graphs with diverse structural properties, our method achieves up to 55x faster inference than metaheuristic baselines and up to 14x faster inference than supervised learning approaches, while finding optimal or near-optimal dominating sets on real-world social network benchmarks. Our learned heuristic generalizes effectively to unseen graph distributions, demonstrating strong practical applicability for large-scale social network analysis.

AI.motivation: 最小支配集（MDS）是NP难组合优化问题，在病毒营销、影响力最大化、公共卫生干预和信息传播等社交网络分析中应用关键。寻找覆盖整个网络的最小影响力个体集合在规模上计算困难，现有元启发式与监督学习方法效率或泛化性受限。

AI.result: 推理速度较元启发式基线最高快55倍，较监督学习方法最高快14倍，在真实社交网络基准上找到最优或近最优支配集，并能有效泛化到未见图分布。
AI.conclusion: 该无监督GNN学习启发式在效率与解质量上均具优势，泛化能力强，适用于大规模社交网络分析。

title: SAILOR: Solver-Assisted Interactive LLM-based Optimization Recovery
summary: Natural-language descriptions of optimization problems may be incomplete or vague about numerical information that a solver requires, including costs, capacities, demands, bounds, and penalties. A language model can translate the description into code, but when a required value is absent it must either stop or guess. We present SAILOR, a proof-of-concept system that detects such unsupported numerical choices, asks the user targeted follow-up questions, and updates the optimization model before returning a solution. Questions are prioritized using uncertainty and solver-derived estimates of how strongly each missing value affects the current model. We evaluate the pipeline on 1,723 instances from seven masked benchmarks using an idealized simulator that returns ground-truth values. Exact objective-value agreement ranges from 27.0% to 87.6% across datasets, with 1.4--5.7 questions per instance on average. These results establish feasibility under controlled branch-and-reveal feedback; they do not measure performance with human users or general structural model repair. Code is available at: https://github.com/sshaghayeghs/SAILOR.

AI.tldr: SAILOR是一个概念验证系统，用于检测自然语言优化问题中缺失或不明确的数值信息，通过针对性追问用户来补全数值并更新优化模型后再给出解。
AI.motivation: 自然语言描述的优化问题常缺失求解器所需的数值信息（成本、容量、需求、边界、惩罚项等）。语言模型虽可将其转为代码，但当关键数值缺失时只能停止或猜测，影响解的可靠性。
AI.method: 系统检测不受支持的数值选择，生成针对性追问并更新优化模型。问题排序基于不确定性与求解器推导出的估计，即每个缺失值对当前模型的影响强度。在七个掩码基准的1,723个实例上，使用返回真值的理想化模拟器评估该流程。
AI.result: 目标值精确一致率在各数据集间为27.0%至87.6%，平均每个实例需1.4至5.7个问题。
AI.conclusion: 结果证明了在受控的分支-揭示反馈下该方法的可行性；但未评估真实用户场景下的表现，也未涉及通用的结构性模型修复。代码已开源。

title: Learning Multimodal One-step Flow Policy via Value-weighted Optimal Transport
summary: Offline reinforcement learning aims to learn a policy solely from fixed datasets, which often contain multimodal action distributions. Flow policies can naturally represent such multimodal behaviors, but learning an efficient one-step flow policy remains challenging: standard value guidance often leads to mode collapse or exploits overestimation bias in out-of-distribution regions. To address this, we introduce One-step Flow policy via Optimal Transport (OptiFlow), a framework for one-step flow policy learning as a structured sample-allocation problem. OptiFlow jointly trains a value-aware reference flow policy and an efficient one-step policy, coupling their action samples through state-wise entropic optimal transport. For each state, critic-estimated values define the priority of distillation target actions, while the action-distance cost ensures geometrically compatible pairings. By avoiding direct critic maximization, our transport-guided approach enables in-distribution exploitation by anchoring the one-step policy to high-value, dataset-supported modes without the risk of out-of-distribution divergence. Experimental results demonstrate that OptiFlow effectively captures optimal multimodal behaviors and achieves strong performance across diverse offline RL benchmarks. Our code is available at https://github.com/Yonsei-DILLab/OptiFlow.

AI.tldr: OptiFlow 提出一种基于最优传输的一步流策略框架，用于离线强化学习，通过将一步策略学习建模为结构化样本分配问题，避免模式崩塌与分布外偏差，有效捕获多模态最优行为。
AI.motivation: 离线强化学习仅从固定数据集学习策略，而数据集常含多模态动作分布，流策略能自然表达此类行为，但学习高效的一步流策略存在困难：标准价值引导易导致模式崩塌，或在分布外区域利用高估偏差。因此需要一种既高效又稳定的方法来学习一步流策略。
AI.method: 提出 OptiFlow 框架，将一步流策略学习建模为结构化样本分配问题。联合训练价值感知的参考流策略与高效一步策略，通过逐状态的熵最优传输耦合两者的动作样本。在每个状态下，评论家估计的价值定义蒸馏目标动作的优先级，动作距离代价则保证几何兼容的配对。该方法避免直接最大化评论家，从而在分布内利用高价值、数据集支持的模态。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，OptiFlow 能有效捕获最优多模态行为，并在多个离线强化学习基准上取得优异性能。
AI.conclusion: OptiFlow 通过最优传输引导的一步流策略学习，在离线强化学习中实现了高效且稳定的多模态策略优化，避免分布外发散，验证了方法在多种基准上的有效性。

title: Early-Stopping Thresholds for ES-HyperNEAT: A Data-Driven Approach from Fitness Dynamics
comment: 8 pages, 5 figures, 9 tables. Accepted version of a paper published at the 2026 IEEE Congress on Evolutionary Computation (CEC), part of the IEEE World Congress on Computational Intelligence (WCCI 2026), Maastricht, Netherlands, 21-26 June 2026. (c) 2026 IEEE
summary: Most hyperparameter configurations for Evolvable-Substrate HyperNEAT (ES-HyperNEAT) produce networks that stagnate at random-guessing performance, wasting computational resources. We frame early stopping as binary classification on early fitness trajectories: for each trial, we compute the cumulative median of best-per-generation fitness and test it against a threshold derived by maximizing the F1 score on an initial 90-trial dataset. The resulting rule (generation G* = 3, threshold T* = 0.140) achieves F1 = 0.872 on 180 independent validation trials, retaining over 90% of successful trials while cutting computational cost by 41.6%. Compared to Hyperband, our domain-specific rule is 64% more efficient with higher mean fitness, though Hyperband occasionally discovers higher peak solutions. On a converged search population the rule becomes too aggressive (recall 31.1%), motivating adaptive thresholds. The specific thresholds are ES-HyperNEAT-specific, but the methodology, deriving stopping criteria from fitness dynamics classification, is applicable to other evolutionary algorithms with stagnation-prone hyperparameter spaces.

AI.result: 在180次独立验证试验上F1=0.872，保留超过90%的成功试验，同时降低41.6%的计算成本；与Hyperband相比，该领域特定规则效率高出64%且平均适应度更高，但Hyperband偶尔能发现更高的峰值解；在已收敛的搜索种群上规则过于激进（召回率仅31.1%）。

title: Big Brains and Changing Environments: Cause or Consequence?
summary: Large brains are metabolically costly, and associations with changing environments do not imply they evolved there, as the Cognitive Buffer Hypothesis (CBH) would suggest. They may instead evolve in stable conditions and later facilitate colonization of changing environments. Using neuro-evolution in an artificial seasonal foraging task, we compared agents evolving exclusively in changing environments to agents first evolved in static environments before transitioning. Results show that larger neural networks in dynamic environments arise mainly from prior static evolution, achieving superior performance under unpredictable changes. Our results challenge strict CBH predictions, provide agent-based (computational) support for a colonization-based account and highlight the role of evolutionary history in brain size evolution.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过人工季节性觅食任务中的神经进化实验，发现大型神经网络（大脑）主要在稳定环境中先期进化形成，随后才促进对变化环境的定殖，而非直接因应变化环境而进化。结果挑战了认知缓冲假说（CBH）的严格预测，为"定殖假说"提供了基于主体的计算支持，并强调进化历史在大脑尺寸演化中的作用。
AI.motivation: 大脑代谢代价高昂，而认知缓冲假说（CBH）认为大型大脑是对变化环境的适应，即与变化环境的关联意味着大脑在该环境中进化而来。作者质疑这一推断，提出另一种可能：大型大脑先在稳定环境中进化，之后才促成对变化环境的定殖。为检验这一替代解释，需要可控的实验框架。

title: Root-Cause Attribution Is a Search Problem: Continual Search for Long-Horizon Agent Failures
summary: The increasing deployment of AI agents in long-horizon tasks yields massive execution logs. Diagnosing failures within these records is crucial for reliability, as it transforms outcome-level signals into actionable interventions. The sheer scale of the data renders human review impractical, driving the need for automated root-cause attribution (RCA). However, automated RCA methods using LLMs suffer from low diagnostic accuracy, especially as execution traces grow larger. They struggle because relevant information is often sparse, distributed across distant actions, and disconnected from the visible failure, reducing root-cause attribution to a massive search problem. Existing RCA methods typically rely on one-shot LLM judgments to diagnose failures from execution traces. While effective for shorter trajectories, these judges tend to settle on a plausible diagnosis early, leaving critical evidence in longer traces unexamined. We introduce Continual Search, an iterative framework that nudges the judge, over successive turns, to keep searching for unresolved diagnostic evidence. We evaluate Continual Search across four existing RCA benchmarks. Recognizing the lack of massive execution traces in current benchmarks, we introduce MegaRCA-Mix to evaluate RCA at scale. MegaRCA-Mix provides a challenging testbed of 50 human-annotated failure trials spanning long-horizon, execution-heavy tasks. Across multiple benchmark suites and model families, Continual Search consistently improves attribution performance. On MegaRCA-Mix, for example, it improves GPT-5.5's F1 score by more than 40\%, from $0.349$ to $0.498$. More interestingly, within the same model family, lower-tier models can even surpass their higher-tier counterparts, demonstrating that effective search supersedes raw model scale.

AI.tldr: 提出 Continual Search 迭代式框架，通过多轮引导 LLM 持续搜索未决诊断证据，显著提升长执行轨迹下的根因归因性能，并发布大规模基准 MegaRCA-Mix。
AI.motivation: AI 智能体在长程任务中产生海量执行日志，人工审查不可行，需自动化根因归因（RCA）。但现有基于 LLM 的 RCA 存在诊断准确率低的问题：相关信息稀疏、分散在相距遥远的动作中，且与表面失败现象脱节，使根因归因退化为大规模搜索问题。现有方法多为一次性 LLM 判断，虽对短轨迹有效，但判断器往往过早锁定一个看似合理的诊断，导致长轨迹中的关键证据未被审查。
AI.method: 提出 Continual Search：一个迭代式框架，在连续多轮中推动判断器（judge）持续寻找尚未解决的诊断证据，而非一次性给出结论。同时针对现有基准缺乏大规模执行轨迹的问题，构建 MegaRCA-Mix 基准，包含 50 个人工标注的失败试验，覆盖长程、执行密集型任务。
AI.result: 在四个已有 RCA 基准及多个模型系列上，Continual Search 均一致提升归因性能。在 MegaRCA-Mix 上，将 GPT-5.5 的 F1 从 0.349 提升至 0.498，提升超过 40%。此外，同一模型系列内的低阶模型甚至可超越高阶模型。
AI.conclusion: 有效的搜索过程比单纯的模型规模更重要，Continual Search 通过迭代式证据搜索克服了长执行轨迹下一次性判断的局限，为规模化 RCA 提供了可行路径。

title: Learning to Solve Hard Problems in RL for LLMs by Never Giving Up
comment: Blog post mnoukhov.github.io/posts/ngu and code available at github.com/mnoukhov/never-give-up
summary: We demonstrate that training LLMs with RL does not improve performance equally across a dataset. RL shows large improvements on easy problems that an LLM is already good at solving, but small improvements on hard problems. We call this the Matthew Effect in RL for LLMs, after the phenomenon of cumulative advantage from economics and network science summarized as "the rich get richer". The naive explanation is that hard problems require more compute to find a solution. We argue that modern RL methods are exacerbating the issue by wasting too much compute on easy problems and instead should dynamically reallocate how they use compute. We introduce Never Give Up (NGU), a simple adaptive sampling method that keeps generating samples for a problem until one is correct. By leveraging asynchronous RL, this naturally uses fewer samples to filter out easy problems and allocates more compute to solving harder problems. We investigate the design choices that affect NGU, such as off-policy robustness, and develop a set of best practices. On the math benchmark Deepscaler, NGU improves performance per compute, especially on harder problems. On a recent coding task, Manufactoria, standard GRPO with a per-test reward fails to fully solve problems that have a range of easy and difficult tests. NGU iteratively improves, solving harder and harder tests, until it learns to fully solve coding problems.

AI.tldr: 该论文指出RL训练LLM存在"马太效应"——简单题提升大、难题提升小，并提出自适应采样方法NGU以动态重分配算力，在数学与代码任务上提升每算力性能，尤其改善难题。
AI.motivation: RL对LLM的性能提升在数据集上分布不均：LLM本已擅长的简单题提升显著，难题提升有限。作者将此归因于现代RL方法在简单题上浪费过多算力，故需动态重分配算力以缓解这一累积优势现象。
AI.method: 提出Never Give Up（NGU），一种简单的自适应采样方法：对某问题持续生成样本直至得到一个正确解。借助异步RL，该方法自然减少用于过滤简单题的样本量，并将更多算力分配给难题。同时研究了影响NGU的设计选择（如off-policy鲁棒性），并总结出一套最佳实践。
AI.result: 在数学基准DeepScaler上，NGU提升了每算力性能，尤其在难题上改善明显；在近期编码任务Manufactoria上，标准GRPO配合逐测试奖励无法完全解决含易难测试梯度的问题，而NGU可迭代改进，逐步解决越来越难的测试，最终学会完整解决代码问题。
AI.conclusion: 现代RL浪费算力于简单题，加剧了对难题提升不足的"马太效应"；NGU通过自适应采样与异步RL重新分配算力，可有效提升每算力性能，并在数学与编程任务上尤其在难题上取得更好效果。

title: HarnessBandit: Joint Learnability-Transferability Scheduling for Multi-Harness Agentic Reinforcement Learning
comment: 13 pages. Equal contribution: Hongliang Wei and Xiaobing Tu. Corresponding authors: Xiaobing Tu and Xiaopeng Fan
summary: Language-model agents are increasingly deployed through diverse harnesses that differ in system prompts, tool schemas, control loops, and trajectory formats. The same model can perform unevenly across these interfaces, making robustness to harness variation an important objective. A natural approach is to train a shared policy through multiple harnesses, but doing so introduces a scheduling problem: each training step should favor a harness that currently provides a useful learning signal while also producing an update that benefits the other harnesses. We develop HarnessBandit, an online scheduler that selects one harness per optimizer step. After a group-relative policy optimization (GRPO) update, it observes learnability -- the mean absolute advantage on the batch -- and transferability -- the cosine between a low-dimensional gradient sketch of the current harness and exponential moving averages of the remaining harnesses. The two signals are fused after pooled sliding-window min-max normalization and sampled with a visit-dependent bonus and an explicit exploration floor. We train Qwen3.5-2B across six harnesses on ClawGym and evaluate on PinchBench (held-out tasks, in-distribution OpenClaw) and ClawEval (held-out tasks and harness). HarnessBandit improves over mixed-batch multi-harness training on both benchmarks, while training diagnostics indicate that learnability and transferability provide distinct, evolving signals.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 HarnessBandit，一种在线调度器，在每个优化器步选择一个 harness 进行训练，通过融合可学习性与可迁移性信号，提升语言模型智能体对 harness 变化的鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 语言模型智能体通过多样的 harness（系统提示、工具模式、控制循环、轨迹格式各异）部署，同一模型在不同接口下表现不均，因此对 harness 变化的鲁棒性成为重要目标。多 harness 联合训练虽可行，但引入调度问题：每步应偏向当前能提供有用学习信号、同时其更新又能惠及其他 harness 的 harness。
AI.method: 提出 HarnessBandit 在线调度器，每步选择一个 harness。在 GRPO 更新后观测两个信号：可学习性（批上平均绝对优势）与可迁移性（当前 harness 的低维梯度草图与其余 harness 指数移动平均之间的余弦相似度）。两信号经池化滑动窗口 min-max 归一化后融合，并以访问依赖奖励和显式探索下限进行采样。
AI.result: 在 ClawGym 上跨六个 harness 训练 Qwen3.5-2B，并在 PinchBench（留出任务、分布内 OpenClaw）与 ClawEval（留出任务与 harness）上评估。HarnessBandit 在两个基准上均优于混合批次多 harness 训练；训练诊断表明可学习性与可迁移性提供相互独立且动态演化的信号。
AI.conclusion: 融合可学习性与可迁移性的在线 harness 调度能有效提升多 harness 智能体训练的泛化能力，且两类信号具有互补性。

title: AppliedScientist: Automated Scientific Revision Through Iterative AI Reviewing
summary: Automated reviewing systems are increasingly evaluated based on the quality of the reviews they produce. Yet a review is only useful if acting on it leads to a measurable improvement in the paper. We present AppliedScientist, a closed-loop system that couples an autonomous AI scientist with an AI reviewer, and evaluate it by iteratively revising rejected papers from a range of research subfields. To mirror how human authors build on earlier drafts, the AI scientist has access to its previous versions during revision. To avoid bias from prior judgments, however, each review is generated independently, with the reviewer having no memory of earlier feedback or scores. We compare three revision settings: one initialized with the original venue reviews, one initialized with AI-generated reviews, and autonomous self-revision using the same fixed prompt in every round. Because the reviewer both guides and evaluates the revision, we also assess the human-initialized revisions using Stanford Reviewer as an independent evaluator. Reviewer-guided revision consistently improves more than fixed-prompt self-revision, and Stanford Reviewer also assigns higher scores to later revisions. AppliedScientist resolves 128 of 150 execution-related weaknesses (85.3%), but only 2 of 18 idea-related weaknesses (11.1%), suggesting that iterative revision is effective at improving experiments and implementation, but rarely changes concerns about novelty or significance.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 AppliedScientist 闭环系统，将自主 AI 科学家与 AI 审稿人耦合，通过迭代修改被拒论文来评估评审的实际效用。审稿引导的修改优于固定提示自修改，能有效解决执行类缺陷（85.3%），但几乎无法解决创新性/重要性类缺陷（11.1%）。
AI.motivation: 自动化评审系统多以生成评审的质量为评估标准，但评审是否有用取决于依据评审修改后论文是否获得可测量的改进。现有评估缺乏对"评审→修改→改进"闭环的度量，作者希望以论文实际修订效果来检验评审的实用性。
AI.method: 构建 AppliedScientist：将自主 AI 科学家与 AI 审稿人耦合成闭环系统，对多研究子领域的被拒论文进行迭代修改。科学家在修改时可访问其历史版本以模拟人类作者行为；但每轮评审独立生成，审稿人无先前反馈或分数的记忆以避免偏差。设置三种修改条件：(1) 以原始投稿评审初始化；(2) 以 AI 生成评审初始化；(3) 每轮使用同一固定提示的自主自修改。由于审稿人既引导又评估修改，另采用 Stanford Reviewer 作为独立评估者对人类评审初始化的修改进行评分。
AI.result: 审稿引导的修改持续优于固定提示自修改；Stanford Reviewer 对后续修订版本给出更高分数。在缺陷解决方面，AppliedScientist 解决了 150 项与执行相关的缺陷中的 128 项（85.3%），但仅解决 18 项与想法相关的缺陷中的 2 项（11.1%）。
AI.conclusion: 迭代修正在改进实验与实现方面有效，但极少能改变关于创新性或重要性的质疑。这表明当前闭环评审-修改系统更擅长修补可执行层面的问题，而对论文核心贡献层面的缺陷帮助有限。

title: When Agents Slow Down: Understanding LLM Agents' Test-Time Strategies via Elo-per-token Analysis
summary: Large language model (LLM) agents allocate test-time compute adaptively as they revise solutions, use tools, explore alternatives, and decide when to stop. This test-time strategy makes it difficult to measure how agent performance scales. We study open-ended tasks that provide continuous scores for intermediate submissions, making progress observable throughout long trajectories. We propose Elo-per-token analysis, which tracks the best solution found at each token budget and uses a Bradley-Terry model to aggregate within-task orderings into Elo ratings across tasks with different score scales. We apply it to four general-purpose agents on four open-ended benchmarks, with sessions of up to 100M tokens, and to three feedback-driven LLM optimization harnesses in controlled single-task interventions. Independent sampling provides a theoretically characterized reference, for which Elo grows linearly with log compute. Against this reference, agents can initially convert tokens into Elo faster than independent sampling, but their marginal gains diminish and eventually fall below the reference. In contrast, the strongest historical human contestants improve superlinearly over contest time on shared AtCoder Heuristic Contest tasks, providing evidence of continual learning and substantial headroom after agents slow down. We define the scaling inflection point as the per-session budget where marginal Elo gains match the independent-sampling reference. Using this point as the per-session budget, we split 100M tokens across parallel sessions on FrontierCS Polyomino Packing, gaining +264 Elo over one long session and +355 over ten short sessions.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 Elo-per-token 分析框架，用 Bradley-Terry 模型将不同分数尺度的开放式任务中的中间解排序聚合为 Elo 评分，以衡量 LLM 智能体在测试时计算扩展下的性能变化。实验发现智能体的边际收益递减并最终低于独立采样参考，而人类顶尖选手在同类竞赛中表现为超线性提升，据此定义的"扩展拐点"可用于优化并行会话预算分配。
AI.motivation: LLM 智能体在测试时会自适应分配计算资源（修改解答、调用工具、探索备选方案、决定何时停止），这种策略使得衡量智能体性能随计算量如何扩展变得困难。现有指标难以在长轨迹中对开放式任务的持续进展进行可比、可跨任务聚合的度量。
AI.method: 提出 Elo-per-token 分析：跟踪每个 token 预算下找到的最优解，并用 Bradley-Terry 模型将任务内的排序聚合成跨任务的 Elo 评分，从而统一不同分数尺度。以独立采样作为理论刻画的可对照基线（其 Elo 随 log 计算量线性增长）。在四个通用智能体、四个开放式基准、单次会话最多 100M token 上实验，并针对三个反馈驱动的 LLM 优化框架做受控单任务干预。定义"扩展拐点"为边际 Elo 增益等于独立采样参考时的单会话预算。
AI.result: 智能体初期将 token 转化为 Elo 的速度快于独立采样，但边际增益递减并最终低于该参考。相比之下，顶尖人类选手在共享的 AtCoder Heuristic Contest 任务上随比赛时间呈超线性提升，表明存在持续学习与显著提升空间。在 FrontierCS Polyomino Packing 上，以扩展拐点作为单会话预算，将 100M token 拆分到并行会话中，相比单个长会话获得 +264 Elo，相比十个短会话获得 +355 Elo。
AI.conclusion: Elo-per-token 提供了一种可跨任务、跨尺度衡量智能体测试时计算扩展的通用方法，揭示智能体存在收益递减与瓶颈，而人类仍具超线性学习能力，说明存在较大提升空间；扩展拐点可作为并行预算分配的有效准则，显著提升总体性能。

title: RESKILL: Explicit Failure Attribution and Structured Repair for Interactive Language Agents
summary: Language agents increasingly rely on reusable skills, but post-failure repair is often handled by opaque one-shot reflection: a model generates a skill patch without explicitly maintaining how failure explanations relate to candidate repairs or how unsuccessful retests should influence later edits. We introduce RESKILL, a structured repair framework that maintains an explicit repair state across repair rounds. Given a failed rollout, the framework links failure hypotheses to candidate skill patches, selects local repairs through coverage-based attribution, retests the edited skill set in the environment, and uses retest outcomes to guide subsequent repair updates. The language model supplies structured repair factors, while the repair procedure records them, compares local skill patches by how well they address active failure explanations, and carries unsuccessful retest outcomes into later repair rounds. We evaluate RESKILL on ALFWorld and TextCraft across three model sizes under fixed repair budgets. RESKILL obtains the strongest final success in all six benchmark-model settings, improving average final success by 3.7 percentage points over direct repair and 3.3 points over hypothesis-conditioned repair. These results suggest that explicit attribution alone is insufficient; durable improvement emerges when attribution is integrated with repair selection and persistent retest-conditioned update.

AI.tldr: RESKILL：一种在修复轮次间维护显式修复状态的结构化技能修复框架，通过将失败假设与候选补丁关联、基于覆盖度归因选择局部修复，并利用重测结果指导后续修复，在ALFWorld与TextCraft上取得最强最终成功率。
AI.motivation: 语言智能体的技能修复多依赖不透明的一次性反思：模型直接生成补丁，既不显式维护失败解释与候选修复的关联，也未将失败重测结果纳入后续编辑。这种缺乏结构化归因与持久状态的做法限制了修复效果的稳定提升。
AI.method: 提出RESKILL结构化修复框架，跨修复轮次维护显式修复状态。给定失败轨迹后：将失败假设与候选技能补丁关联；通过基于覆盖度的归因选择局部修复；在环境中重测编辑后的技能集；并将重测结果用于指导后续修复更新。语言模型提供结构化修复因子，修复流程记录这些因子、依据对活跃失败解释的覆盖程度比较局部补丁，并把不成功的重测结果延续至后续轮次。
AI.result: 在ALFWorld与TextCraft上，针对三种模型规模、固定修复预算进行评测。RESKILL在全部六种基准-模型设置下均取得最优最终成功率，较直接修复平均提升3.7个百分点，较假设条件化修复提升3.3个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 仅靠显式归因并不充分；只有当归因与修复选择、以及由重测结果条件化的持久更新相结合时，才能带来稳定的性能提升。

title: RSIAgent: Autonomous Exploration for Recursive Self-improvement in New Environments
summary: Digital agents must often adapt to new environments whose interfaces, tools, and failure modes are not fully captured by pretrained models. We introduce \textbf{RSIAgent}, a training-free multi-agent framework for recursive self-improvement through autonomous memory construction. RSIAgent coordinates curriculum, actor, and verifier agents to continually explore the environment, validate outcomes, and retain environment-specific knowledge, including reusable causal relationships between actions, conditions, and consequences. It further adopts a \textbf{broad-then-deep} exploration strategy, combining parallel broad recursive self-exploration for discovering diverse environment structures with focused deep self-exploration for uncovering hard cases, hidden constraints, boundary conditions, and previously unknown causal dependencies. The resulting memory is frozen and can be directly reused for downstream tasks without updating model parameters. Experiments on OSWorld-v2 and Agent's Last Exam show that RSIAgent substantially improves strong open-source models, enabling Kimi-K3 and GLM-5.3 to outperform frontier closed-source models including GPT-6.

AI.tldr: 提出无需训练的多智能体框架 RSIAgent，通过自主记忆构建实现递归自我改进，在 OSWorld-v2 与 Agent's Last Exam 上显著提升开源模型表现。
AI.motivation: 数字智能体常需适应新环境，而预训练模型无法充分覆盖其界面、工具与失败模式，因此需要一种无需更新参数即可持续适应环境的方法。
AI.method: RSIAgent 协调课程智能体、执行智能体与验证智能体，持续探索环境、验证结果并保留环境特定知识（含动作、条件与后果间可复用的因果关系）；采用"先广后深"探索策略，结合并行广域递归自探索以发现多样环境结构，与聚焦式深度自探索以挖掘难例、隐藏约束、边界条件及未知因果依赖；所得记忆被冻结，可直接复用于下游任务。
AI.result: 在 OSWorld-v2 与 Agent's Last Exam 上，RSIAgent 大幅提升强开源模型，使 Kimi-K3 与 GLM-5.3 超越包括 GPT-6 在内的前沿闭源模型。
AI.conclusion: 无需参数更新的自主记忆构建与递归自我改进框架可有效提升数字智能体的环境适应能力，并具备跨任务复用性。

title: Cloud Workflow Scheduling Based on Graph Attention-Driven Hierarchical Reinforcement Learning
comment: Paper submitted to IEEE Internet of Things Journal
summary: Dynamic cloud workflow scheduling must balance deadline satisfaction, container utilization, and energy consumption while dealing with stochastic task-execution speeds, placement-dependent communication, and coupled task and container decisions. Workflows are naturally modeled as directed acyclic graphs (DAGs), but conventional vector- or matrix-based states do not fully capture their dependency topology. To better represent task urgency and structural relationships, we assign predicted sub-deadlines to tasks and use a multi-head graph attention network (GAT) to extract dependency information from the evolving DAGs. Based on these representations, we develop a Graph Attention-Driven Hierarchical Reinforcement Learning (GA-HRL) framework and model the scheduling process as an event-driven hierarchical semi-Markov decision process (SMDP). Workflow arrivals and task completions trigger scheduling events. At each scheduling event, the Task Scheduling (TS) agent first processes the currently ready tasks by assigning them to admissible existing containers or requesting new ones. The requested containers are then processed by the Container Scheduling (CS) agent for host placement before the environment advances. The two agents are trained alternately using separate Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO). Experiments on the 2018 Alibaba cluster trace show that GA-HRL maintains competitive workflow success rate and, in settings where success is comparable, generally achieves higher container utilization and lower energy consumption. Under the largest speed variation, it trades a small success-rate margin for substantially lower energy. Simulation code is available at: https://github.com/zongjin130/GA-HRL.

AI.tldr: 提出GA-HRL框架，用多叉图注意力网络表示DAG依赖结构，将云工作流调度建模为事件驱动的分层半马尔可夫决策过程，由任务调度与容器调度两个智能体交替用PPO训练，在Alibaba 2018集群数据上取得更优的容器利用率与能耗表现。
AI.motivation: 云工作流调度需在截止时间满足、容器利用率与能耗之间权衡，同时面临任务执行速度随机、通信开销与放置位置相关、任务与容器决策耦合等挑战。工作流天然为DAG，但传统向量/矩阵状态难以充分刻画其依赖拓扑，因此需要更适合的表示与调度方法。
AI.method: 为任务分配预测子截止时间以表征紧迫度；采用多头图注意力网络从动态演化的DAG中提取依赖信息；构建GA-HRL分层强化学习框架，将调度过程建模为事件驱动的分层SMDP，工作流到达与任务完成触发调度事件；TS智能体先为就绪任务分配至可用容器或请求新容器，CS智能体再为请求的容器选择宿主机；两智能体用独立PPO交替训练。
AI.result: 在2018 Alibaba集群轨迹上，GA-HRL保持有竞争力的工作流成功率；在成功率相当的设置下，通常获得更高的容器利用率和更低的能耗；在最大速度波动场景下，以较小的成功率损失换取显著的能耗降低。
AI.conclusion: GA-HRL通过图注意力表示与分层强化学习有效联合优化任务与容器调度，验证了结构感知表示和多智能体分层决策在云工作流调度中的有效性，代码已开源。

title: HiGFRL: Hierarchical Graph Fusion-Driven Reinforcement Learning for Dependency-Aware Task Scheduling in Heterogeneous Cloud
summary: Online scheduling of dependency-aware tasks in heterogeneous cloud clusters is a fundamental yet challenging problem due to the complex interplay between DAG topologies and multi-dimensional resource constraints. While DRL has shown promise, existing GNN-based approaches often struggle to efficiently model high-order topological dependencies and suffer from loose coupling between task and resource states, leading to myopic scheduling decisions. To address these limitations, we propose HiGFRL, a Hierarchical Graph Fusion-Driven Reinforcement Learning framework. HiGFRL constructs a novel three-level state representation comprising a Static Hypergraph, a Dynamic Global Graph, and a Local Bipartite Graph to explicitly model the interplay between task dependencies and real-time cluster dynamics. Specifically, we design a fusion-driven dual-network architecture to optimize RL decision-making, where a Context Fusion Allocator integrates local bipartite matching features with fused global context to execute precise task-to-node allocation, and a Global State Evaluator leverages the global dynamic graph representation to accurately estimate expected long-term cumulative reward. Furthermore, we incorporate a topology-prior-guided hybrid reward mechanism that distills static topological priors into the learning process to accelerate convergence. Extensive experiments using real-world Alibaba cluster traces demonstrate that HiGFRL significantly outperforms heuristics and DRL baselines. Specifically, in challenging large-scale high-load scenarios, HiGFRL reduces the Makespan by up to 32.55%, and optimizes the average task flow time and average task wait time by 13.58% and 13.79%, respectively. Experimental results confirm that HiGFRL not only significantly improves cluster throughput but also ensures superior QoS by substantially reducing queuing delays. Code Release:https://github.com/igeng/HiGFRL.

AI.tldr: 提出HiGFRL，用三层图表示与双网络融合强化学习解决异构云集群中依赖感知任务的在线调度问题。
AI.motivation: 异构云集群中依赖感知在线调度因DAG拓扑与多维资源约束的复杂耦合而困难；现有基于GNN的DRL方法难以高效建模高阶拓扑依赖，且任务与资源状态耦合松散，导致调度决策短视。
AI.method: HiGFRL构建三层状态表示：静态超图、动态全局图与局部二部图，显式建模任务依赖与实时集群动态的交互。设计融合驱动双网络架构：Context Fusion Allocator将局部二部匹配特征与融合全局上下文结合以执行精确的任务到节点分配；Global State Evaluator利用全局动态图表示估计期望长期累积回报。此外引入拓扑先验引导的混合奖励机制，将静态拓扑先验蒸馏进学习过程以加速收敛。
AI.result: 基于真实Alibaba集群trace的实验中，HiGFRL显著优于启发式与DRL基线。在大规模高负载场景下，Makespan最多降低32.55%，平均任务流时间与平均任务等待时间分别优化13.58%与13.79%。
AI.conclusion: 结果确认HiGFRL显著提升集群吞吐量，并通过大幅减少排队延迟保证更优QoS。代码已开源。

title: Learning to Solve Stochastic Controls with Unknown Drifts and Running Rewards: Theory, Algorithms and Convergence
summary: We study continuous-time and possibly high-dimensional stochastic control problems where drift coefficients and running reward functions are unknown. Due to these missing model primitives, we take the exploratory, reinforcement learning (RL) framework of Wang, Zariphopoulou, and Zhou(2020) with relaxed controls and entropy regularization. The objective is to develop theoretically grounded, efficient and scalable RL algorithms to learn both the optimal value functions (which also solve the exploratory HJB equation) and optimal exploratory feedback control policies. When the diffusion coefficients do not contain control, we employ probabilistic representations of both the optimal value function and its gradient based on an auxiliary state process depending only on the diffusion part of the original dynamics. With a delicate analysis on some properly defined mappings and their fixed points, this leads to the introduction of our policy iteration algorithms and their convergence. We demonstrate the performance of our algorithms through various numerical examples. Finally, we study a special control-dependent diffusion case where probability representation of the Hessian is called for.

AI.tldr: 本文在探索性强化学习框架下，研究漂移项与奖励函数未知的连续时间（可能高维）随机控制问题，提出基于概率表示的政策迭代算法并证明收敛性。
AI.motivation: 现实中漂移系数与运行奖励函数等模型要素往往未知，难以直接求解探索性HJB方程，因此需要开发理论上严谨、高效且可扩展的RL算法，同时学习最优值函数与最优探索性反馈控制策略。
AI.method: 采用Wang、Zariphopoulou与Zhou(2020)的探索性RL框架（松弛控制与熵正则化）。在扩散系数不含控制时，基于仅依赖原动态扩散部分的辅助状态过程，给出最优值函数及其梯度的概率表示；通过对定义的映射及其不动点的细致分析，构造政策迭代算法并证明收敛性。进一步研究控制依赖扩散的特殊情形，需借助Hessian的概率表示。
AI.result: 建立了值函数与梯度的概率表示，提出了政策迭代算法并给出收敛性证明；通过多个数值例子验证了算法性能。
AI.conclusion: 所提算法能够在模型要素缺失情形下高效学习最优值函数与探索性控制策略，并为控制依赖扩散等更一般情形提供了基于Hessian概率表示的扩展方向。

title: Discovery Foundation Models: Toward Open-Ended Discovery Intelligence
summary: Foundation models have progressed from learning and reasoning over existing knowledge, to increasingly learning through action, tool use, and outcome feedback. We argue that the next frontier is a further transition: from solving and acting within problems specified by humans to participating in the process by which new problems, representations, explanations, and knowledge are created. We refer to this capability as Discovery Intelligence. We formulate Discovery Foundation Models (DFMs) as general-purpose model systems for open-ended discovery. A DFM operates over a revisable research state and supports seven coupled capabilities spanning problem discovery, formulation, representation construction, hypothesis formation, intervention, evidence-grounded revision, and continual discovery improvement. We instantiate this framework with Zetema, which couples explicit research-state dynamics, verification and experimental gating, external grounding, and cross-task Discovery Skill evolution. We further ground the framework with GALILEO, a real therapeutic-discovery system in which Dry-Lab reasoning, robotic and hands-on Wet-Lab experimentation, external biological evidence, and iterative hypothesis and design revision form a closed physical discovery loop. We then formulate a unified approach to capability formation and process-centered evaluation, enabling discovery behavior to be trained, improved, and measured beyond final-answer performance. Together, these components establish discovery as a learnable, executable, and evaluable capability of foundation-model systems. We view this shift as a broader progression in intelligence scaling: from learning over existing knowledge, to learning from action outcomes, and ultimately to participating in the construction, testing, and revision of the structures through which new knowledge is discovered. Code: https://github.com/Gen-Verse/DFM-Plans

AI.tldr: 该文提出"Discovery Intelligence"与"Discovery Foundation Models (DFMs)"框架，并实例化为Zetema与GALILEO系统，力求将"发现"变为基础模型可学习、可执行、可评测的能力。
AI.motivation: 基础模型已从对既有知识的学习与推理，发展到通过行动、工具使用和结果反馈进行学习。作者认为下一前沿是进一步转变：从解决人类给定的问题，转向参与新问题、新表示、新解释与新知识的创造过程，即"发现智能"。
AI.method: 提出DFM作为面向开放式发现的通用模型系统，运行在可修正的研究状态（revisable research state）之上，支持七项耦合能力：问题发现、问题形式化、表示构建、假设形成、干预、基于证据的修正、持续发现改进。以Zetema实例化，结合显式研究状态动态、验证与实验门控（experimental gating）、外部 grounding 与跨任务发现技能演化（Discovery Skill evolution）。并以真实治疗发现系统GALILEO落地，形成干实验室推理、机器人与人工湿实验室实验、外部生物证据、迭代假设与设计修正构成的闭环物理发现回路。同时提出统一的能力形成与以过程为中心的评测方法。
AI.result: 构建了DFM框架并给出Zetema与GALILEO两个实例，提出统一的能力形成与过程中心评测方案，使发现行为可训练、可改进，并可超越最终答案性能进行度量。
AI.conclusion: 将发现确立为基础的模型系统中可学习、可执行、可评测的能力，并把这一转变视为智能扩展的更广泛进程：从既有知识学习，到从行动结果学习，最终参与到新知识发现所依赖结构的构建、检验与修正之中。

title: Refinement-based Flow Policy Optimization
summary: Flow-based policies offer an expressive representation for online reinforcement learning, but conventional flow matching requires samples drawn from the distribution to be modeled. This poses a challenge when the desired action distribution is defined only implicitly by a Q-function, since directly sampling actions from the resulting distribution is generally intractable. We propose Refinement-Based Flow Policy Optimization (RFPO), a novel framework for training a flow policy in online reinforcement learning by alternating between Q-guided sample refinement and self-target flow matching. RFPO first generates actions from Gaussian noise using the current flow policy and then uses a finite-step stochastic refinement procedure to move them toward an energy-based distribution induced by the Q-function. Each refined action is then paired with its corresponding initial noise sample and used as a fixed target for flow-matching training. By repeatedly refining its own outputs and learning from the resulting targets, RFPO incorporates Q-guidance into the policy without requiring direct samples from the target distribution, while retaining the capacity to represent multiple action modes. We further provide a theoretical analysis of the distributional dynamics induced by RFPO. Across six continuous-control tasks, RFPO matches or outperforms a standard Gaussian-policy baseline on almost every task. Experiments on six synthetic two-dimensional target distributions with diverse geometries demonstrate that RFPO captures complex multimodal structure without mode collapse.

AI.tldr: RFPO通过交替进行Q引导的样本细化和自目标流匹配，在在线强化学习中训练流策略，无需直接从隐式定义的目标分布中采样。
AI.motivation: 基于流的策略具有表达力强的优势，但传统流匹配需要从待建模分布中采样；当期望的动作分布仅由Q函数隐式定义时，直接采样通常不可行。因此需要一种无需直接采样目标分布的流策略训练方法。
AI.method: 提出Refinement-Based Flow Policy Optimization（RFPO）框架：先用当前流策略从高斯噪声生成动作，再通过有限步随机细化过程将其推向由Q函数诱导的能量分布；随后将每个细化后的动作与其初始噪声样本配对，作为流匹配训练的固定目标。通过反复细化自身输出并从中学习，将Q引导融入策略。
AI.result: 在六个连续控制任务上，RFPO在几乎所有任务上达到或超过标准高斯策略基线；在六个具有多样几何结构的二维合成目标分布实验中，RFPO能捕捉复杂多模态结构且无模式坍塌。还对RFPO诱导的分布动态进行了理论分析。
AI.conclusion: RFPO无需直接从目标分布采样即可将Q引导融入流策略，同时保留表示多种动作模式的能力，并在连续控制与多模态分布实验中表现良好。

title: Bellman Policy Optimization
summary: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) improves the reasoning capabilities of large language models (LLMs). We introduce Bellman Policy Optimization (BPO), a critic-free method derived from Policy Mirror Descent (PMD). For autoregressive generation with terminal rewards, BPO uses the Bellman equations to reformulate PMD as a trajectory-level objective. The reformulation avoids estimating state values at intermediate states. We prove that it has the same unique optimal solution as the original PMD objective. We derive the practical BPO loss by approximating this objective. Its mismatch-correction weight is a smoothed ratio of complementary token probabilities. Experiments on mathematical reasoning benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness of BPO.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Bellman Policy Optimization（BPO），一种无 critic、基于策略镜像下降（PMD）推导的 RLVR 方法。BPO 利用 Bellman 方程将 PMD 改写为轨迹级目标，避免中间状态值估计，并证明与原始 PMD 目标具有相同唯一最优解，在数学推理基准上验证有效。
AI.motivation: 现有 RLVR 方法（如依赖 critic 的 PPO 类算法）需估计中间状态价值函数，带来额外模型与计算开销、训练不稳定等问题。作者希望设计一种无需 critic、仅利用终端奖励的轨迹级优化方法，同时保持与 PMD 类目标的理论一致性。
AI.method: 以 Policy Mirror Descent 为理论起点，针对带终端奖励的自回归生成场景，利用 Bellman 方程将 PMD 重构为轨迹级目标，从而绕过中间状态价值估计；理论上证明该重构目标与原 PMD 目标具有相同且唯一的最优解；据此通过近似该目标导出实用 BPO 损失，其失配修正权重为互补 token 概率的平滑比值。
AI.result: 在数学推理基准上的实验表明 BPO 具有有效性（提升 LLM 推理能力），验证了该无 critic 轨迹级优化方法的可行性。
AI.conclusion: BPO 作为一种无 critic 的 RLVR 方法，通过 Bellman 方程将 PMD 转化为轨迹级目标，在保持理论最优解一致性的同时规避了状态值估计，为提升 LLM 推理能力提供了一条简洁有效的优化路径。

title: Algorithmic Information Dynamics of Learning: A Certified, Differentiable Complexity Controller for Grokking
summary: Algorithmic Information Dynamics (AID) studies systems by perturbing them and measuring changes in algorithmic complexity, but its usual estimator, the Block Decomposition Method, is piecewise constant, restricting the calculus to finite differences. We use $K^{\mathrm{CDM}}_{\mathrm{s}F}$, a certified, differentiable estimator, to bring the calculus into learning dynamics: grokking, where a complexity order parameter is known but has not been made to act. A\empts a transient loss kick, the estimator becomes a controller that accelerates grokking in Levin's description-length--versus-time sense, within a data-dependent Occam boundary whose finite-size trend, $f_c\sim\ln p/p$, is consistent with a coupon-collector interpretation. Ablations show that a complexity gate matches a train-loss gate in rescuing failing seeds with $27\%$ less intervention; among the tested signals, only map complexity marks the transition's completion; the certified prior and the per-parameter $\nabla K$ attribution are both fungible (a uniform-prior sensor makes bit-identical gate decisions, and random supports match $\nabla K$-selected ones above a sparsity threshold); and direct field perturbation shows a nucleation-like response to the Occam field (no linear regime is resolved over the probed amplitudes, so these measurements do not justify a fluctuation--dissipation surrogate), with a finite-field response growing by orders of magnitude toward the transition. These measurements account for the empirically tuned staircase: bang--bang pulses, stall-fired and released on yield, whose iteration plausibly builds the response it exploits. The kick transfers to sparse parity and to a transformer; a sustained weight-space loss fails. The algorithmic estimator's distinct contribution is timing (when to fire and when to release), not attribution.

AI.tldr: 本文用可微的认证复杂度估计器 K^CDM_sF 取代分片常数的块分解法,把算法信息动力学(AID)的微积分引入学习动力学,将复杂度估计器用作控制器来加速 grokking;结果表明其独特贡献在于时机控制(何时施加、何时释放),而非归因。
AI.motivation: AID 通过扰动系统并测量算法复杂度的变化来研究系统,但其常用估计器——块分解法(BDM)——是分片常数(piecewise constant)的,使得微积分只能退化为有限差分,无法用于连续的动力学分析。同时,grokking 现象中虽已有复杂度序参量,却未被用于实际干预。作者希望借助可微估计器,让复杂度成为可参与学习动力学的控制信号。
AI.method: 采用认证且可微的估计器 K^CDM_sF;固定损失函数,施加短暂的"损失踢动"(transient loss kick),使估计器成为控制器,在 Levin 的"描述长度—时间"意义下加速 grokking,并受数据依赖的 Occam 边界约束。做了多项消融:比较复杂度门控与训练损失门控;检验不同信号是否标记相变完成;检验认证先验与逐参数 ∇K 归因的作用;对 Occam 场进行直接场扰动以观察响应。
AI.result: Occam 边界的有限尺度趋势 f_c ~ ln p / p,与优惠券收集(coupon-collector)解释一致。消融显示:复杂度门控与训练损失门控在挽救失败种子时效果相当,但干预量减少 27%;在所测试信号中,只有映射复杂度(map complexity)标记了相变的完成;认证先验与逐参数 ∇K 归因均可替代(均匀先验传感器给出比特级相同的门控决策,随机支撑在稀疏度阈值以上可与 ∇K 选择的支持匹配);直接场扰动显示对 Occam 场呈成核式(nucleation-like)响应,在探测振幅范围内未分辨出线性区(故不支持涨落—耗散替代),有限场响应在趋近相变时增长数个数量级。这些测量解释了经验调好的阶梯式策略:bang–bang 脉冲,按产额触发与释放,其迭代恰好构建了它所利用的响应。
AI.conclusion: 该踢动策略可迁移到稀疏奇偶校验(sparse parity)任务和 Transformer 上,而持续性的权重空间损失则失败。算法估计器的独特贡献是时机控制(何时触发、何时释放),而不是归因。

relevance.reason: 利用可微算法复杂度估计器作为学习动态控制器，涉及优化控制与算法信息动力学，与核心兴趣有较强关联。

title: ABSOL: Aggregated Bayesian Subsampling Orchestrated with LLMs
summary: Large language models are increasingly used as natural-language interfaces to structured data, yet they remain unreliable when answers require consistent evidence conditioning, dependency-aware reasoning, and uncertainty estimation. Bayesian networks provide an explicit probabilistic reasoning layer, but learning useful structures from data remains costly and fragile at scale. We introduce ABSOL, a hybrid LLM-guided Bayesian network structure-learning framework that uses LLMs as bounded semantic guides. Across five discrete BN benchmarks spanning 27 to 1041 nodes, ABSOL is the only evaluated method to produce a viable graph on every benchmark, and achieves the highest Edge F_1 on every benchmark larger than 27 nodes with GPT-5.4. The four LLM augmentations, which contribute complementary semantic evidence to the statistical backbone, improve Edge F_1 over the non-LLM aggregation backbone by +0.23 on average. Complementary post-hoc refinement experiments suggest that these gains depend in part on limiting the LLM's authority over the final structure. Together, these results show that language-derived semantic knowledge can substantially improve scalable probabilistic structure learning when used as bounded guidance within a statistically grounded reasoning pipeline. The code for ABSOL is available at github.com/megagonlabs/absol-bn.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出ABSOL，一种以LLM作为受限语义引导的混合式贝叶斯网络结构学习框架，在多个离散贝叶斯网络基准上取得最优或唯一可行的图结构学习结果。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型作为结构化数据的自然语言接口时，在需要一致证据条件化、依赖感知推理与不确定性估计的场景下仍不可靠。贝叶斯网络可提供显式概率推理层，但从数据中学习有用结构在大规模下依然代价高且脆弱。因此需要探索如何将语言语义知识与统计学习相结合。
AI.method: ABSOL是一个LLM引导的混合式贝叶斯网络结构学习框架，将LLM作为"有界"（bounded）语义引导，而非直接决定最终结构。框架以统计学习为骨干（backbone），并融入四种LLM增强（augmentation），为统计骨干提供互补的语义证据。此外还进行了事后精修（post-hoc refinement）实验以检验LLM权限范围的影响。
AI.result: 在五个离散贝叶斯网络基准（节点数从27到1041）上，ABSOL是唯一在所有基准上均产出可行图的评估方法；在使用GPT-5.4时，在每一个大于27个节点的基准上都取得最高的Edge F_1。四种LLM增强相较无LLM的聚合骨干平均提升Edge F_1约+0.23。事后精修实验表明，这些增益部分依赖于限制LLM对最终结构的权限。
AI.conclusion: 当语言衍生的语义知识被作为有界引导、置于统计基础的推理流程中时，可显著提升可扩展的概率结构学习性能。代码已开源。

title: Salesforce Koa: An Enterprise Language Model for Agentic Tool Use
summary: We present Salesforce Koa, an enterprise language model built by post-training the open-weight Nemotron-3-Super-120B foundation model with reinforcement learning using Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO). Salesforce Koa is trained on public and synthetically generated data, with no customer data, to improve tool use and agentic capabilities while preserving strong general-purpose performance. Its distinctive component is a simulation-to-reward pipeline that expands workflow specifications into persona-conditioned multi-turn tasks with task-resolution rewards grounded in successful tool use for data-dependent requests. For enterprise domains, these specifications are written in Agent Script, Salesforce's declarative language for building Agentforce agents; for public tool-use domains, we synthesize the workflow structure directly. The same simulation and grounded-reward machinery drives GRPO across both. Across public tool-use, agentic-reasoning, and enterprise Customer Relationship Management (CRM) benchmarks, Salesforce Koa improves over its open-weight base, with the clearest gains on multi-turn tool use, and surpasses a strong proprietary baseline while remaining below the strongest frontier models. These results show that specification-driven reinforcement learning is a practical path to specializing open-weight foundation models for enterprise agentic tasks.

AI.tldr: Salesforce Koa 是基于 Nemotron-3-Super-120B 通过 GRPO 强化学习后训练的企业级语言模型，其核心是"仿真到奖励"流水线，将工作流规范扩展为带人格条件的多轮任务，并以工具调用成功为落地奖励，从而提升工具使用与智能体能力。
AI.motivation: 企业级智能体任务需要强大的工具使用与多轮决策能力，而开放权重基础模型在数据依赖型请求上表现不足；同时企业场景缺乏可直接使用的、带落地奖励的多轮交互训练数据。
AI.method: 以开放权重 Nemotron-3-Super-120B 为基座，使用公开与合成数据（不含客户数据）进行 GRPO 强化学习后训练。关键组件为 simulation-to-reward 流水线：将工作流规范扩展为 persona-conditioned 多轮任务，并构造以成功工具使用为条件的任务完成奖励。企业领域规范以 Agent Script（Salesforce 构建 Agentforce 智能体的声明式语言）编写，公开工具使用领域则直接合成工作流结构；同一套仿真与落地奖励机制统一驱动两类的 GRPO 训练。
AI.result: 在公开工具使用、智能体推理以及企业 CRM 基准上，Salesforce Koa 相对其开放权重基座均有提升，多轮工具使用提升最显著，并超过一个强专有基线，但仍低于最强的前沿模型。
AI.conclusion: 规范驱动的强化学习（specification-driven RL）是将开放权重基础模型专门化到企业智能体任务的一条可行路径。

title: SkillLift: Learning Dense Rubrics from Sparse Oracles for Efficient Skill Evolution
summary: LLM-based agents increasingly rely on persistent skills, i.e., reusable procedural prompts, to adapt without weight updates. Existing skill self-evolution methods directly revise skill text based on execution feedback, but each oracle evaluation requires a full agent rollout, creating a supervision bottleneck that confines search to failure-patching updates. Our key insight is that ranking is a smoother supervision target than absolute outcome regression: identifying which skill is better requires fewer oracle evaluations than predicting exact scores. Building on this insight, we propose SkillLift, which decouples skill search from oracle cost by learning an oracle-aligned rubric as a structured evaluation space. We formalize this as a bilevel optimization problem solved via alternating optimization: an inner loop uses the frozen rubric as a cheap surrogate to guide skill revision at no oracle cost, while an outer loop invokes a small number of oracle rollouts to re-align the rubric via rank correlation, amortizing oracle cost and stabilizing text-space updates. Experiments on complex agent task benchmarks show that our method outperforms existing auto-skill methods with 40--70\% less token cost compared to frontier evolving methods. Codes are available at https://github.com/WalteR-MittY-pro/SkillLift.

AI.tldr: 提出 SkillLift，通过将技能搜索与 oracle 成本解耦，学习一个 oracle 对齐的评分准则（rubric）作为结构化评估空间，以双层优化交替求解，在复杂智能体任务上以更少 token 成本超越现有自动技能方法。
AI.motivation: 基于 LLM 的智能体依赖可复用的持久技能（程序化提示）来免权重更新地适应任务。现有技能自演化方法直接依据执行反馈修改技能文本，但每次 oracle 评估都需完整 agent rollout，形成监督瓶颈，使搜索局限于"打补丁式"的失败修复更新。
AI.method: 核心洞见：排序是比绝对结果回归更平滑的监督目标——判断哪个技能更优所需的 oracle 评估次数少于预测精确分数。据此提出 SkillLift，将技能搜索与 oracle 成本解耦：学习一个 oracle 对齐的 rubric 作为结构化评估空间，形式化为双层优化问题并用交替优化求解。内层以冻结 rubric 作为廉价代理，零 oracle 成本地指导技能修订；外层仅调用少量 oracle rollout，通过秩相关重新对齐 rubric，从而摊销 oracle 成本并稳定文本空间更新。
AI.result: 在复杂智能体任务基准上，该方法优于现有自动技能方法，相比前沿演化方法减少 40%–70% 的 token 成本。代码已开源。
AI.conclusion: 通过将排序式监督引入 rubric 学习，SkillLift 有效缓解了技能自演化中的 oracle 监督瓶颈，在提升技能质量的同时显著降低评估开销。

relevance.reason: LLM智能体技能的自动演化与搜索，采用双层优化和廉价代理评估降低oracle成本，属于LLM驱动的优化/演化设计，与自动算法设计与LLM智能体优化器方向相关。

title: TimeThink: Eliciting Compositional Reasoning in Timeseries Large Language Models
summary: Timeseries multimodal large language models (TS-MLLMs) have recently begun leveraging the reasoning capabilities of large language models (LLMs) for question-answering tasks. However, these models often fail to capture dynamic temporal patterns, providing only implicit reasoning that lacks the underlying explanations critical for high-stakes applications like healthcare. While reinforcement learning (RL)-based timeseries language models aim to address this, they often fall short because they are trained on narrow, in-distribution data and struggle with out-of-distribution compositional questions. To address these challenges, we present TimeThink, a synthetic framework for eliciting compositional timeseries reasoning. Core timeseries primitives (e.g., trend, seasonality) are domain-independent and can be deterministically generated. Guided by this premise, TimeThink first designs a synthetic data generator that produces atomic and composite question-answer pairs, providing objective ground truth with reasoning traces. Building on this framework, TimeThink employs a reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) training strategy that encourages explicit reasoning. Unlike template-reliant methods, this approach enables the model to learn the underlying logic of composition rather than simply imitating traces. Extensive experiments show that TimeThink, trained only on synthetic data, significantly outperforms strong baselines on both synthetic and real-world benchmarks.

AI.tldr: TimeThink 提出一个合成数据框架与 RLVR 训练策略，通过可确定生成的时间序列原语构建原子与复合问答对，使 TS-MLLM 学会显式组合式时序推理，仅用合成数据即在合成与真实基准上显著超越强基线。
AI.motivation: 现有时间序列多模态大模型（TS-MLLM）难以捕捉动态时序模式，其推理多为隐式，缺乏高风险场景（如医疗）所需的可解释依据；而基于强化学习的时间序列语言模型又受限于训练数据狭窄、分布内，难以应对分布外的组合式问题。
AI.method: TimeThink 基于"时序原语（趋势、季节性等）与领域无关且可确定生成"这一前提，先设计合成数据生成器，产出原子与复合问答对，提供带推理轨迹的客观真值；再采用可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）训练策略，鼓励显式推理，使模型学习组合的内在逻辑而非模仿模板轨迹。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，TimeThink 仅使用合成数据训练，即可在合成与真实世界基准上显著优于强基线。
AI.conclusion: 通过合成数据驱动的组合式推理框架与 RLVR，可有效提升时序多模态大模型的显式、可泛化组合推理能力，并在真实任务上展现良好迁移性。

title: OrchSLM: Probing the Dynamics of Small Language Model Orchestration
summary: Although large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated remarkable capabilities, their reliance on cloud-scale infrastructure poses fundamental challenges for deployment in agentic pipelines, including latency, privacy, connectivity, and substantial computational cost. Small language models (SLMs) offer a compelling alternative: recent studies suggest that many repetitive and narrowly scoped subtasks in agentic workloads may be better served by specialized SLMs than by monolithic LLMs. However, the limited capacity and context windows of SLMs can constrain long-horizon reasoning and interaction-heavy orchestration strategies such as iterative verification and debate. This motivates a complementary, non-interactive paradigm in which heterogeneous SLMs independently generate candidate solutions and a router orchestrates their cached samples without further model interaction. To further understand the mechanisms of such orchestration, we introduce OrchSLM, a routing framework that unifies existing non-interactive orchestration methods and exposes their underlying design choices as controllable parameters. Using OrchSLM as a systematic probe, we reveal how orchestration behavior emerges from diverse knobs, including the task structure, model-pool composition, and multi-agent consensus.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 OrchSLM，一个统一非交互式编排方法的SLM路由框架，并将设计选择暴露为可控参数，用于系统探究编排行为如何由任务结构、模型池组成与多智能体共识等因素涌现。
AI.motivation: LLM依赖云规模基础设施，在智能体流水线中面临延迟、隐私、连通性和高算力成本问题；SLM是替代方案，但容量和上下文窗口有限，难以支持长时程推理与迭代验证、辩论等交互密集型编排。这促使研究者探索一种互补的非交互式范式：异构SLM独立生成候选解，由路由器编排其缓存样本而不进行进一步模型交互。
AI.method: 引入 OrchSLM 路由框架，统一现有非交互式编排方法，并将其底层设计选择暴露为可控参数；以 OrchSLM 作为系统性探针，分析任务结构、模型池组成、多智能体共识等多种“调节旋钮”对编排行为的影响。
AI.result: 摘要为背景性/框架性介绍，未给出具体实验数据或量化结果；其发现是揭示编排行为如何从任务结构、模型池组成与多智能体共识等多样旋钮中涌现。
AI.conclusion: 非交互式编排是SLM智能体流水线中具有潜力的互补范式；OrchSLM为理解和系统研究此类编排机制提供了统一、可控的分析框架。

title: Asclepius: An Adaptive Harness for Long-Horizon Clinical Agents
summary: LLM agents are predominantly benchmarked on short, single-task trajectories, yet real deployments run for hours under contention, surfacing a different class of failures. We use the Clinical Environment Simulator (CES), in which an agent manages an entire emergency-department shift under continuous time and resource pressure, as a testbed: long-horizon execution failures manifest measurably in a single rollout under structured, multi-dimensional grading. On CES, current agents reach the correct diagnosis in most cases yet fail to deliver complete and timely critical actions, revealing an execution gap. We attribute this gap to three long-horizon failure modes, each operationalized as a per-trace counter: instruction-adherence drift, treatment incompleteness, and a severity-equity gap in timeliness. We then introduce Asclepius, an adaptive agent scaffolding with a self-evolving harness that rewrites the operating manual between shifts from trace-level feedback, an externalized clinical skills library for high-stakes regimen knowledge, and three isolated subagents that partition per-turn decisions across the patient queue. On held-out batches never observed during harness evolution, Asclepius improves critical-action correctness by 22% (p = 0.024) over a strong baseline agent framework while preserving diagnostic accuracy, with consistent gains across five LLM judges from three model families; on the full ten-batch set, improvements reach 25% on critical actions and 13% on timeliness. The three failure modes form a coupled bottleneck: decisive reductions appear only when all three components act together.

AI.tldr: 论文提出临床环境模拟器（CES）作为长时程LLM智能体测试平台，揭示"执行鸿沟"并归纳三类长时程失效模式，进而提出Asclepius自适应脚手架系统，在关键动作正确性与及时性上显著超越强基线。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM智能体评测多局限于短时、单任务轨迹，而真实部署需在资源竞争下连续运行数小时，会暴露另一类失效。作者希望以急诊科整班次管理这一连续时间与资源压力场景为测试床，在单次rollout中可量化地刻画长时程执行失效。
AI.method: 采用临床环境模拟器（CES）与结构化多维评分；将执行鸿沟归因于三类长时程失效模式，并各自操作为逐轨迹计数器：指令遵循漂移、治疗不完整、及时性上的严重度公平差距。提出Asclepius自适应智能体脚手架，包含：可在班次间依据轨迹级反馈重写操作手册的自演化harness、面向高风险治疗方案知识的外部化临床技能库，以及将每轮决策按患者队列切分的三个隔离子智能体。
AI.result: 当前智能体在CES上多数能给出正确诊断，但无法完成完整且及时的关键动作。在harness演化中从未观察过的留出批次上，Asclepius相对强基线框架将关键动作正确率提升22%（p=0.024），同时保持诊断准确率，并在来自三个模型家族的五个LLM评审中表现一致；在全部十个批次上，关键动作提升达25%、及时性提升13%。
AI.conclusion: 三类失效模式构成耦合瓶颈，只有三个组件协同作用时才出现决定性改善。CES表明长时程执行能力应作为独立评测维度，而自适应脚手架与结构化外部知识可有效弥合执行鸿沟。

title: AutoTailor: Automatic, User-Aligned Capability Selection and Adaptation for Web Agents
summary: Web agents can utilize reusable tools to reduce the cost and latency of low-level browser interaction, but automatically discovered tool collections can be large, redundant, and poorly aligned with user demand. We present AutoTailor, a meta-agentic framework for constructing and maintaining a compact set of trajectory-derived Model Context Protocol (MCP) APIs. Offline, AutoTailor converts web trajectories into parameterized browser-automation programs, applies a Quality Filter to remove APIs with unsuitable granularity and redundant functionality, and applies a Usage Likelihood Filter to prioritize broadly useful capabilities while preserving semantic coverage. Online, Dynamic Reselection monitors task outcomes and API usage, identifies recurring coverage gaps, adds relevant candidates, and prunes persistently unused capabilities. We evaluate AutoTailor on 106 WebArena Postmill tasks. Offline filtering reduces the initial 1,283 unrefined APIs to 87, and Dynamic Reselection produces a 33-API set. With reasoning and acting (ReAct) fallback, this set achieves 90.6% correctness, compared with 87.5% for ReAct alone, while reducing average total request-token cost by 57.8% and latency by 29.4%. Without ReAct, it achieves 60.1% correctness, marginally matching the performance of unrefined set, while reducing request-token usage by 94.9%. Together, these results show that static filtering produces a compact inventory of APIs expected to support core, high-likelihood tasks, while dynamic reselection further tailors that inventory to observed user needs. This combination improves accuracy and latency while sharply reducing token usage and end-to-end cost, demonstrating the value of user-aligned capability management for efficient web agents.

AI.tldr: AutoTailor 是一个元代理框架，用于构建和维护精简的、由轨迹派生的 MCP API 集合，通过离线过滤与在线动态重选提升 Web 智能体的准确性、降低开销。
AI.motivation: Web 智能体可复用工具来降低浏览器底层交互的成本与延迟，但自动发现的工具集合往往规模庞大、冗余且与用户需求对齐不佳。
AI.method: 离线阶段将 Web 轨迹转换为参数化浏览器自动化程序，通过 Quality Filter 剔除粒度不当与功能冗余的 API，并用 Usage Likelihood Filter 优先保留广泛有用的能力同时维持语义覆盖；在线阶段通过 Dynamic Reselection 监控任务结果与 API 使用情况，识别反复出现的覆盖缺口，补充相关候选并剪除长期未使用的能力。
AI.result: 在 106 个 WebArena Postmill 任务上评估：离线过滤将初始 1,283 个未精炼 API 缩减至 87 个，动态重选进一步得到 33 个 API 的集合。配合 ReAct 回退时正确率达 90.6%（ReAct 单独为 87.5%），平均总请求 token 成本降低 57.8%、延迟降低 29.4%；不使用 ReAct 时正确率为 60.1%，与未精炼集合基本持平，而请求 token 使用量降低 94.9%。
AI.conclusion: 静态过滤可生成支持核心高概率任务的精简 API 清单，动态重选则进一步依据观测到的用户需求定制该清单；二者结合在提升准确率与降低延迟的同时大幅减少 token 消耗与端到端成本，体现了面向用户需求对齐的能力管理对高效 Web 智能体的价值。

relevance.reason: 面向Web智能体的LLM智能体框架，自动筛选与适配MCP工具集，涉及智能体工具选择与优化，与LLM智能体优化方向相关，但非核心的组合优化或进化计算算法设计。

title: Efficient Online Inverse Optimization with $O(d)$ Regret
summary: We give a deterministic algorithm for online inverse linear optimization with regret $O(d)$, uniform in the horizon and $O(d^{2})$ time per round. A bound of this order was obtained recently by Dewasurendra, settling a question of Gollapudi et al.\ and of Oki and Sakaue, but by an improper rule that enumerates covers at every scale and costs $T^{Θ(d)}$ a round; ours is the first efficient such bound and the first proper one. We build on the variable-metric framework of Sakaue et al., adding a self-normalized rank-one update, and we replace the $\log\det$ potential by the trace power $\tr(H^{-1/2})$, which is bounded outright and removes the $\ln T$. The bound also holds against an expert that does not optimize, and we give corruption-robust and rank-adaptive variants, and an application to convex minimization.

AI.tldr: 本文提出首个高效且"proper"的在线逆线性优化确定性算法，每轮O(d²)时间、总遗憾O(d)，兼具有腐坏鲁棒性与秩自适应变体，并应用于凸最小化。
AI.motivation: 在线逆线性优化此前最优的O(d)遗憾界由Dewasurendra给出，但其规则是"improper"的，需在每个尺度上枚举覆盖（cover），每轮代价高达T^{Θ(d)}，实际不可行；同时该界还带ln T因子。作者希望同时解决效率与proper性两个问题。
AI.method: 基于Sakaue等人的变尺度（variable-metric）框架，引入自归一化秩一更新（self-normalized rank-one update）；将原\text{log}\det势函数替换为迹幂\text{tr}(H^{-1/2})，该量天然有界，从而消除ln T项。
AI.result: 得到确定性算法，遗憾O(d)且对时间horizon一致（uniform），每轮O(d²)时间；这是首个高效的此类界，也是首个proper规则。该界对不进行优化的专家（expert）同样成立；并给出腐坏鲁棒（corruption-robust）和秩自适应（rank-adaptive）变体，以及凸最小化的应用。
AI.conclusion: 通过势函数替换与秩一更新，作者在保持O(d)遗憾的同时将每轮开销从T^{Θ(d)}降至O(d²)，实现了首个高效、proper的在线逆线性优化算法，并拓展到鲁棒、秩自适应及凸优化场景。

relevance.reason: 在线逆线性优化的高效算法，属于优化算法设计方向，但与LLM/EC/RL交叉较弱。
relevance.title_zh: 具有O(d)遗憾的高效在线逆优化

title: A Hybrid Agentic AI Framework for Intelligent Supply Chain Analytics
summary: Efficient utilization of supply chain analytics for decision making remains a significant challenge for planners, as critical tasks such as database querying, key performance indicator (KPI) analysis, demand forecasting, and performance diagnosis require heterogeneous expertise spanning data engineering, operations research, and domain knowledge. In this work, we propose an agentic system for supply chain analytics that bridges the gap between business decision-making and technical expertise, where a coordinator agent interprets user intent and delegates sub-tasks to specialized agents. The system supports both exploratory analysis and deterministic workflows, enabling planners to transition between ad hoc questions and structured processes. Domain logic is encapsulated within specialist agents and prompts, yielding a scalable, modular, and auditable design and lowering the cost of functional extension through prompt-centric development. We evaluate the proposed architecture on a test environment that replicates multi-echelon inventory management operations. Results show that our multi-agent design achieves a 90\% accuracy, which is competitive with a single agent baseline while reducing input token usage by roughly fourfold, substantially improving scalability and cost-efficiency. Furthermore, we provide case studies to demonstrate interpretable suboptimality detection and automated forecast optimization, illustrating how agentic architectures can effectively combine open-ended exploratory analysis and deterministic supply chain analytics workflows, and provide a practical pathway toward more accessible and extensible decision-support systems.
